verdict.rationale: Khoj documents sharing files and folders (PDF, Word, markdown, org-mode, plaintext, Notion, GitHub) that it keeps in sync and uses to ground chat responses. It shows the reference notes behind each answer and offers a /notes mode and file filters to restrict answers to your own content. A community user praised the Obsidian integration, but another reported poor search over Slovene notes, which limits confidence in retrieval quality rather than contradicting the capability. Missing for 10: strong independent hands-on corroboration of grounding accuracy, and evidence of reliable retrieval for non-English notes.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them

citations.quote: Share your files, folders with Khoj using the app. Khoj will keep these files in sync to provide contextual responses when you search or chat.
Khoj can understand your word, PDF, org-mode, markdown, plaintext files, and Notion pages.
Shows reference notes used to generate a response
/notes: Limit chat to only respond using your notes, not just Khoj's general world knowledge as reference
When relevant, it'll use any notes or documents you shared with it to respond.
